source_text:
3.29 Τοῦ
αὐτοῦ· πρὸς μελίσσασ Πρὸς δὲ τὰ ἔντομα, σφῆκας, μελίσσας, ἀνθρήνας, τενθρηδόνας,
βομβυλίους, βέμβικας, δάφνης φύλλα κατάπλασσε ἢ μαλάχης ἢ σισυμβρίου ἢ
κορίου. Ποιεῖ δὲ καὶ βόλβιτον καταχριόμενον ὀπός τε συκῆς σὺν συκαμίνου φύλλοις
ἢ καλαμίνθη ἢ φακὸς σὺν ἐλαίῳ χριόμενος. Ἄπληκτα δὲ τὰ ζῷα τηρεῖ σικύου ἀγρίου
ῥίζα ἐλαίῳ συνεψηθεῖσα <...> ὅθεν ἀλείφειν αὐτὰ χρὴ χαλβάνην σὺν ἐλαίῳ. Ὁμοίως
δὲ τοῦτο καὶ θυμιώμενον πρὶν ἀνοῖξαι τὰ σμήνη ἀπλήκτους διατηρεῖ, ἢ
μελισσόφυλλον ἐλαίῳ τρίψαντα ἀλείφειν, ἢ βόλβιτα θυμιᾶν ἢ ἐλελίσφακον. Πᾶν δὲ
ἔντομον ἐλαίῳ ἐπιρρανθὲν ἀναιρεῖται.
pass_a_gloss: 3.29 Of-the-same: toward bees. Toward but the insects, wasps, bees, hornets, tenthrēdones, bombylii, bembices, of-laurel leaves plaster or of-mallow or of-sisymbrium or of-coriander. It-does but also dung being-smeared-on sap both of-a-fig with of-a-mulberry leaves or calamint or a-lentil with oil being-anointed. Unstruck but the animals it-keeps of-wild-cucumber a-root with-oil having-been-boiled-together <...> whence to-anoint them it-is-necessary galbanum with oil. Likewise but this also being-fumigated before to-open the hives unstruck it-keeps-through, or bee-leaf with-oil having-rubbed to-anoint, or dungs to-fumigate or sage. Every but insect with-oil having-been-sprinkled-on is-destroyed.
pass_b_english: Of the same: against bees. Against the insects — wasps, bees, hornets, tenthrēdones, bombylii, and bembices — plaster leaves of laurel, or of mallow, or of sisymbrium, or of coriander. Dung smeared on also works, and fig-sap with mulberry leaves, or calamint, or lentil anointed with oil. Root of wild cucumber boiled together with oil keeps the creatures unstruck <...>; therefore one must anoint them with galbanum and oil. Likewise this, being fumigated before the hives are opened, keeps them unstung; or anoint having rubbed melissa with oil; or fumigate dung or sage. Every insect sprinkled with oil is killed.

choices.why: ἀνθρήνη is a hornet. Not a beetle.
Lock wasp-name. Not a centipede (that is σκολόπενδρα at 3.27).
μαλάχη is the plant. Not malachite.
σισύμβριον is water-mint / bergamot-mint. Not sycamore.
κόριον is coriander. Not dust, and not κόρη.
βόλβιτον is dung (typically cattle). Not a bulb and not a coined 'bulbit'.
σικύος ἄγριος is the wild / squirting cucumber. Not rue (πήγανον).
χαλβάνη is the resin. Not chalybeate (iron-water).
Imperative of καταπλάσσω: apply a poultice of the named leaves. Not a bare list of plants.
rejected: a list of leaves with no verb

choices.why: Keeps the creatures from being struck (and keepers unstung when hives are opened). Not a general 'uninjured preserved'.
συκάμινος is the mulberry / sycamine, with fig-sap. Not sycamore, which the crib also used for sisymbrium.
The bee-plant (lemon balm). Not a made-up 'bee leaf' as a separate species.
rejected: bee leaf as an unknown plant

choices.why: ἐπιρραίνω is to sprinkle on. Not 'drenched'.
In this insect list βέμβιξ is the wasp, not a spinning-top.

anf_compare.notes: No PD English of the Cesti body; ANF has the letters only.
